title: fix(state): share agent write admission with trajectory producers

commit.messageHeadline: fix: keep I/O responsive during queued session writes
fix(state): share agent write admission with trajectory producers
fix(gateway): join worker event writes before acknowledgment

No blocking introduced defect was found. **Priority:** P2 **Reviewed head:** `46a0ed3630e3aa6530e1828c32817607d59585ae` ## Review scores | Measure | Result | What it means | |---|---|---| | **Overall readiness** | 🐚 platinum hermit **(4/6)** | A coherent owner-level repair with meaningful regression coverage and no identified blocking defect. | | **Proof confidence** | 🌊 off-meta tidepool | Not applicable: The ordinary contributor-proof gate does not apply to this maintainer-authored repair. Source and regression coverage connect queued trajectory persistence to RPC settlement and revocation checks; the separately declared integrated performance acceptance remains outstanding. | | **Patch quality** | 🐚 platinum hermit **(4/6)** | No actionable review findings were identified. | ## Verification | Check | Result | Evidence | |---|---|---| | **Real behavior** | Not applicable | Not applicable: The ordinary contributor-proof gate does not apply to this maintainer-authored repair. Source and regression coverage connect queued trajectory persistence to RPC settlement and revocation checks; the separately declared integrated performance acceptance remains outstanding. | | **Evidence reviewed** | 9 items | Current-main necessity: Current main clears pendingEvents and queuedBytes before calling the synchronous append; an append exception therefore loses the buffered batch.
Latest-release comparison: Inspection of v2026.9.4 at the supplied release commit shows the same clear-before-append implementation and no new agent write-admission files.
Shared admission and handle lifetime: The helper captures environment and paths before waiting, shares the canonical queue, checks an expected borrowed handle after admission, and retains it through callback settlement. Worker reservations disable inherited foreground reentrancy. | | **Findings** | None | None. | | **Security** | None | None. | ## How this fits together Trajectory recording stores diagnostic events alongside agent sessions in SQLite. Session reclamation and worker progress reporting share these databases, so write scheduling affects Gateway responsiveness and acknowledgment timing. ```mermaid flowchart TD A[Session writes] --> D[Per-agent write queue] B[Trajectory event batches] --> D C[Reclamation worker] --> D D --> E[SQLite database] B --> F[Worker event settlement] E --> F F --> G[Recheck current worker authority] G --> H[Acknowledgment and terminal fence] ``` ## Before merge - [ ] **Resolve merge risk (P1)** - The declared integrated 500 ms Swarm responsiveness target remains unverified; focused correctness coverage does not establish that performance result. - [ ] **Complete next step (P2)** - Land the declared prerequisite https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/146491 and satisfy the PR's stated integrated 500 ms Swarm acceptance gate before landing.

Do we have a high-confidence way to reproduce the issue? Yes, from source: an append exception on current main discards the already-cleared trajectory batch. The branch includes targeted failure and contention regressions; this review did not execute them. Is this the best way to solve the issue? Yes. Extending the existing queue and lifecycle owners addresses the failure without adding a competing store, schema, or configuration mode. AGENTS.md: found and applied where relevant. Worker reservations disable inherited foreground reentrancy. ([`src/state/openclaw-agent-db-write.ts:17`](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/46a0ed3630e3aa6530e1828c32817607d59585ae/src/state/openclaw-agent-db-write.ts#L17), [46a0ed3630e3](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/46a0ed3630e3aa6530e1828c32817607d59585ae)) - **Acknowledgment and authority ordering:** The receiver joins accepted trajectory promises and retains its window through final validation. The RPC owner awaits that operation under its existing environment lock and revalidates placement, credentials, and shutdown state before updating acknowledgment cursors or terminal fences. ([`src/gateway/worker-environments/worker-turn-rpc.ts:530`](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/46a0ed3630e3aa6530e1828c32817607d59585ae/src/gateway/worker-environments/worker-turn-rpc.ts#L530), [46a0ed3630e3](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/46a0ed3630e3aa6530e1828c32817607d59585ae)) - **Focused regression coverage:** Read the registered-dispatch tests for persisted, failed, revoked, and stopped outcomes, including no early response or durable cursor update; additional tests cover failed-batch retry, captured paths, callback failure, duplicate acknowledgment, and eviction during settlement. Tests were inspected, not executed in this read-only review. ([`src/gateway/worker-environments/live-events-settlement.test.ts:23`](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/46a0ed3630e3aa6530e1828c32817607d59585ae/src/gateway/worker-environments/live-events-settlement.test.ts#L23), [46a0ed3630e3](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/46a0ed3630e3aa6530e1828c32817607d59585ae)) - **Private facade and storage contract:** The documentation explicitly limits the additive operation to the existing private SQLite facade and preserves caller-owned transactions and authorization. The introduced delta changes no schema, retention limit, configuration default, dependency, or public typed SDK contract. Public docs: [`docs/plugins/sdk-runtime/state-and-system.md`](https://docs.openclaw.ai/plugins/sdk-runtime/state-and-system). ([`docs/plugins/sdk-runtime/state-and-system.md:193`](https://docs.openclaw.ai/plugins/sdk-runtime/state-and-system), [46a0ed3630e3](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/46a0ed3630e3aa6530e1828c32817607d59585ae)) Likely related people: - **steipete:** Suggested for follow-up; no historical authorship or introduction is verified. (role: unverified routing candidate; confidence: low) ### Rank-up moves Optional improvements that raise the rating; they are not merge blockers. - Record the outcome of the already-declared integrated 500 ms Swarm acceptance gate. ### Rating scale | Score | Internal tier | Crab rank | Meaning | |---:|:---:|---|---| | **6/6** | S | 🦀 challenger crab | Exceptional readiness | | **5/6** | A | 🦞 diamond lobster | Very strong readiness | | **4/6** | B | 🐚 platinum hermit | Good normal PR; ordinary maintainer review | | **3/6** | C | 🦐 gold shrimp | Useful, but confidence is limited | | **2/6** | D | 🦪 silver shellfish | Proof or implementation needs work | | **1/6** | F | 🧂 unranked krab | Not merge-ready | | N/A | NA | 🌊 off-meta tidepool | Rating does not apply | Overall follows the weaker of proof and patch quality.
